title: aaj dunya me janabe fatima paida hui
body:
aaj dunya me janabe fatima paida hui
syeda paida hui qairunnis paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
ashrafe hawwao saara o janabe haajera
faqre maryam ifteqaare aasia paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya-e tat'heer jinki shaan me nazil hui
aaj baaghe dehr me wo taahera paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
noor se mamoor saara aaj aalam hogaya
ghar me noore haq ke noore kibria paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai padhkar durood ahle zameeno aasmaa'n
duqtare mehboobe haq salle alaa paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
leti hai aakar balaae'n quld se ek ek hoor
aaj naswaane jahan ki rehnuma paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
ab jahan me sab rahenge raahato aaram se
qalq ki haajat rawa mushkil kusha paida hui
